title: Junior AI Engineer
description: We are seeking a motivated Junior AI Engineer to help build next-generation intelligent agents and RAG applications. You will collaborate with senior researchers to fine-tune transformer models, develop REST APIs using FastAPI, and implement vector retrieval pipelines using pgvector and PostgreSQL. Ideal candidates have strong Python fundamentals, familiarity with deep learning frameworks, and a passion for LLM agent workflows.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description: Nexus HealthTech is building predictive clinical diagnostic tooling. As a Senior MLE, you will design, train, and deploy real-time inference systems processing multimodal biomedical data. You will own the full MLOps lifecycle from feature engineering to production monitoring using Kubernetes and MLflow. Requires 5+ years of production ML deployment experience.

title: Backend Python Developer
description: FinFlow is looking for a Mid-level Backend Developer to design high-throughput payment settlement microservices. You will architect robust SQL data models, optimize PostgreSQL indexes, write automated pytest suites, and build secure asynchronous transaction processing systems with Redis and Celery. 3+ years of backend web framework experience required.

title: Full Stack Engineer (React & Python)
description: Join our fully remote team building analytics dashboards for B2B SaaS founders. You will own feature delivery end-to-end: from designing interactive frontend views in React and Tailwind CSS to developing secure FastAPI endpoints with JWT authentication and PostgreSQL backend storage.

title: LLM Solutions Architect
description: Cognitive Cloud advises Fortune 500 enterprises on deploying generative AI architectures. You will architect enterprise-scale multi-agent workflows, implement hybrid vector search systems using pgvector, benchmark LLM hallucination and latency using modern eval frameworks, and design secure tool-calling agent systems.

title: Frontend Developer (React / TypeScript)
description: PixelCraft is seeking a talented Frontend Engineer with strong aesthetic sense and deep React expertise. You will create responsive, accessible web interfaces, craft intuitive data visualizations using Recharts, and collaborate closely with product designers to ship delightful user experiences.

title: Data Scientist (NLP & Recommendation)
description: Develop personalization algorithms that power product discovery for 20 million shoppers. You will analyze clickstream behavior, build content-based and collaborative filtering recommendation engines, evaluate metrics such as NDCG and MRR, and deploy machine learning models in production.

title: Cloud DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer
description: We are seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer to scale our multi-region Kubernetes clusters. You will write reusable Terraform modules, maintain secure automated CI/CD pipelines, optimize cloud spend, and ensure 99.99% uptime for microservices serving international customers.

title: Data Engineer (ETL & Pipelines)
description: Design and monitor automated ETL pipelines handling terabytes of financial and operational event streams. You will optimize complex SQL queries, manage scheduled Airflow DAGs, and ensure data consistency across data lakes and relational analytics warehouses.

title: AI Research Intern
description: Great opportunity for undergraduate or graduate students passionate about foundation models. You will assist senior AI scientists in benchmarking retrieval algorithms, experimenting with agent architectures, evaluating prompt variations, and writing clean, reproducible Python research code.

title: Cybersecurity & Security Operations Engineer
description: Sentinel Shield safeguards critical national infrastructure. You will conduct threat assessments, implement automated vulnerability scanning in container pipelines, review API authentication mechanisms, and respond to security incidents.

title: QA Automation & Test Engineer
description: Help us maintain world-class software reliability. You will write comprehensive end-to-end integration test suites in Pytest and Playwright, automate regression testing across web APIs, and integrate automated verification gates into GitHub Actions CI pipelines.

title: Lead Software Architect
description: Lead the modernization of enterprise systems serving 50M+ requests per hour. You will define architectural roadmaps, guide engineering standards across 6 teams, evaluate emerging AI technologies, and ensure zero-downtime reliability.

title: Junior Backend Developer
description: Fantastic first or second role for a junior backend engineer. You will collaborate with senior mentors to build RESTful endpoints, write database migration scripts, implement unit tests with pytest, and learn production microservice architecture.

title: AI Product Manager
description: Translate cutting-edge generative AI capabilities into intuitive enterprise products. You will work at the intersection of AI researchers, software engineers, and corporate customers to define product specs, establish quality benchmarks, and drive product roadmap execution.
